headline: Junior Graphic Designer
tagline: Junior designer with strong visual foundations, template experience, and a track record of delivering 100+ digital and print creatives.

skills.label: Design & Visuals
skills.items: Typography, layout, visual hierarchy, colour systems, branding and visual identity, print production

skills.label: Tools & Software
skills.items: Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, CorelDRAW, Framer, Webflow, Miro, Notion

skills.label: Process & Workflow
skills.items: Print-ready file management, design systems, wireframing, prototyping, AI-assisted design workflows

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Collaborated with HR and management stakeholders to deliver assets within low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready file preparation including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Developed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses and startups.
Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Conducted usability testing and applied findings to improve user flows and interface usability.
Produced wireframes and prototypes for product visuals.
Worked with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.

projects.name: Social Campaign for a Fashion Brand
bullets: Delivered an Instagram and Facebook series that contributed to a 15% increase in follower engagement.

projects.name: Branding Kit for AT Creation Startup
bullets: Designed comprehensive visual identity assets including logo, typography, and color palette.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her commercial graphic design experience at Ascent Business Solutions, highlighting production speed, template systems, and foundational visual skills directly matching the Junior Graphic Designer role.
